### Part 1 · Before you arrive

Accounts and data only. Nothing here needs software installed at home.

1. Download this week's dataset from the course Drive folder into your `IMSE456` cloud folder.
2. Open the week's Colab notebook and run the first cell to confirm it loads. Ten minutes, from any machine.
:::

::: {.part}
### Part 2 · What you will have at the end

SA5 — three estimates, the spread, the histogram, the forced choice with justification
:::

::: {.part}
### Part 3 · Build it yourself — 25 minutes

1. In Excel or Numbers, compute the analogous estimate from two past projects, and the parametric estimate from a cost-per-unit model with its calibration data.
2. In Colab, compute three-point PERT t<sub>e</sub> and σ for twelve work packages; sum them; compute the project σ.
3. Run ten thousand Monte Carlo trials with numpy. Plot the cost distribution. Read off P50 and P80.
4. Compare P50 to the simple sum of most-likely values. They are not equal, and the gap is the entire lesson.
:::

::: {.part}
### Part 4 · Now the professional tool — 20 minutes

1. Enter the bottom-up estimates as durations and costs in ProjectLibre.
2. Read the project total — and note that the tool gives you no uncertainty at all.
:::

::: {.part}
### Part 5 · Where do they disagree? — 15 minutes

ProjectLibre reports one number; your simulation reports a distribution. Which number goes in the charter, and what goes beside it?

Write one paragraph. **This is the graded part** — it is the only thing here a machine cannot check.
:::

::: {.part}
### Part 6 · Run the check

Run the `verify()` cell at the end of the notebook. It tests your own outputs against tolerances and
prints a completion code. If it fails, you have found your error while it is still cheap to fix —
that is the point of it. Paste the code into your submission.
:::

::: {.part}
### Part 7 · Done looks like — the checklist your neighbour runs on you at minute 65

- [ ] The three methods differ by at least 25%
- [ ] P80 exceeds the sum of most-likely values and the team can say why
- [ ] the choice names a stakeholder
:::

::: {.part}

`IMSE456/studio-05/` in your cloud folder. Name files `SA5_yourlastname.*`.

left at home. Your work is reviewed in the session itself — there is no separate submission afterwards.
:::
